proof_roadmap: Three of four arrows are quasi-isomorphisms (proof lines 14483-14487).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that tensoring any complex against a quasi-isomorphism of K-flat complexes yields a quasi-isomorphism of total complexes. The proof replaces the arbitrary complex by a K-flat resolution and considers the commutative square of total complexes built from the resolution, the original complex and the two K-flat complexes. Since the vertical maps induced by the resolution and the top horizontal map induced by the given quasi-isomorphism are quasi-isomorphisms, the bottom horizontal map is one as well, which is the assertion.
